title: idemcore-verifier: open log format, verifier and evidence for bit-identical LLM inference across CPUs, phones and GPUs
description:
Open half of Idemcore, an integer-only LLM inference engine whose runs are bit-identical across x86-64 CPUs, ARM phones and NVIDIA GPUs. This archive contains the hash-log format specification (v1, including batched multi-stream logs), a dependency-free Python verifier, the measurement methodology, and raw per-token hash logs from real runs: Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-7B (8-bit and 4-bit) and gpt-oss-20b/120b on x86-64, Galaxy Z Fold5 (Android), Windows ARM64, NVIDIA T4, A10, A10G, L40S and H100, plus 40 batched GPU logs (B = 1 to 64, shuffled and staggered schedules). One command (python3 -m idemcore_verify samples) recomputes every published digest from the logs and prints PASS or FAIL.

The inference engine itself is not included and is not open source.
